enchantments.tooltip: Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +40 (Equipment bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Strength +6: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.

Levik's Defender: With 2 items equipped - +3 Insight bonus to AC, 20% Additional Melee Threat, Unlisted Fortitude and Will Save +1 (Stacks with most but not Parrying/Greater Parrying). With 3 items equipped - +5 insight AC, 30% Additional Melee Threat (Threat stacks, but only with non-like amounts)
